method: apps/web/bench.html (layers=real): stress fixture (seed 1), every stage layer real, with the flash governor's cap lifted (an infinite budget) so the layers run at full load; the busiest second looped for 8 s after a 1 s warm-up at x1; fixed DPR per case; fresh WebGL context per case; render sanity check before timing. Same machine and method as B07; it checks that B10's per-segment flare attribute and per-frame governor check cost nothing measurable. Values rounded to 0.1 ms.
